proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem Dense.continuous_upperBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    upperBounds (f '' S) = upperBounds (range f) := by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ fun _ => upperBounds_mono (Set.image_subset_range f S) le_rfl
  have hcl : range f ⊆ closure (f '' S) := hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS
  simpa [upperBounds_closure] using (upperBounds_mono_set hcl)

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem Dense.continuous_sup {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) (h : BddAbove (range f)) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ s : S, f s := by
  rw [← sSup_range, ← sSup_range]
  obtain (_ | _) := isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · simp [Set.range_eq_empty]
  refine (isLUB_csSup (range_nonempty f) h).unique ?_
  refine (isLUB_congr (hS.continuous_upperBounds hf)).mp (isLUB_ciSup_set ?_ hS.nonempty)
  -- `BddAbove (f '' S)` follows from `BddAbove (range f)` by monotonicity.
  simpa [Set.image_eq_range] using h.mono (Set.image_subset_range f S)

requested_change: Replace the `grind` call proving `BddAbove (f '' S)` from `BddAbove (range f)` with a direct `mono` proof and `simpa`.

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem Dense.continuous_sup' {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ s : S, f s := by
  rw [← sSup_range, ← sSup_range]
  obtain (_ | _) := isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · simp [Set.range_eq_empty]
  by_cases h1 : BddAbove (range f)
  · refine (isLUB_csSup (range_nonempty f) h1).unique ?_
    refine (isLUB_congr (hS.continuous_upperBounds hf)).mp (isLUB_ciSup_set ?_ hS.nonempty)
    simpa [Set.image_eq_range] using h1.mono (Set.image_subset_range f S)
  · -- reduce unboundedness of the restricted range to unboundedness of `range f` via monotonicity
    have h2 : ¬ BddAbove (range fun s : S => f s) := by
      intro h2
      apply h1
      have : BddAbove (f '' S) := by
        simpa [Set.image_eq_range] using h2
      have : BddAbove (range f) := by
        rcases this with ⟨a, ha⟩
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        simpa [upperBounds] using (show a ∈ upperBounds (range f) from by
          simpa [hS.continuous_upperBounds hf] using (show a ∈ upperBounds (f '' S) from ha))
      exact this
    simp [csSup_of_not_bddAbove h1, csSup_of_not_bddAbove h2]

requested_change: In `Dense.continuous_sup'`, replace the `grind`-based boundedness proof with `simpa [Set.image_eq_range] using h1.mono (Set.image_subset_range f S)`, and simplify the unbounded case by proving `¬ BddAbove (range fun s : S => f s)` via contradiction: from `BddAbove` on the subtype range get `BddAbove (f '' S)`, then transport it to `BddAbove (range f)` using `hS.continuous_upperBounds hf`.
